metadata.title: Dataset TrainBatch1 for the MICCAI-2022-Challenge: Airway Tree Modeling (ATM'22)
metadata.description:
Dataset for the MICCAI-2022-Challenge: Airway Tree Modeling (ATM'22)

This is the TrainBatch1. 

We provide the casename correspondence information in the TrainBatch1_CaseInfo.csv file.  It is convinient for researchers to locate the original cases in LIDC-IDRI with our provided full airway annotation for other research purposes.

If you use this dataset in your research, you must cite the papers in the References below !!!
